title: Senior Product Designer
description:
WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

Cello helps businesses turn their users into their best acquisition channel. Our product is the easiest way to embed user and partner referrals directly into the products you love to use. With just a few lines of code, a company is set up for hyper growth that runs on autopilot instead of spending money on ads.

Teams at Bolt, Miro, Typeform, VEED, and Descript already run their referral programs on Cello. which is proof that word-of-mouth can be engineered as a real growth channel, not being a nice to have.

We're a small, remote-first team that builds infrastructure that lives in other people's products. That means our bar for craft and attention to detail is exceptionally high. Our UI has to feel native inside other people's products that we don't control, our components have to hold up wildly across different use cases, and our decisions get scrutinized by the world's best growth, design and engineering teams. So in addition to caring deeply about how things look and feel, we need people who can think in systems, tracing how a decision plays out across different user segments and across levels of the product.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to work closely with our founding designer, product and engineering teams on the core Cello experience. You'll be involved in every aspect of the product design cycle and expected to take ownership of the work end-to-end.

This role is fully remote but your work schedule needs to overlap comfortably with a European work day. We're an async-first culture that values deep focused work, but we still make time to get together in person at regular team off-sites.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Partner directly with our founding designer, product and engineering teams to take projects on our roadmap from rough problem to shipped solution.

- Look for opportunities to improve our existing product areas. Sometimes that's a full rethink of how something works, others itʼs fixing smaller quality issues you pick up in the product.

- Help define and improve our evolving design system.

- Bring our brand to life across marketing, social and launch content.

- Design mockups and prototypes in low and high fidelity to communicate ideas and how things might work.

- Be part of and contribute to a growing design culture that's still taking shape.

- Sweat the details that make embedded UI feel trustworthy.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Solid and proven software design experience

- Youʼve ideally designed software for SaaS businesses, but we also love to see range in the type of products youʼve worked on.

- Breadth of craft: Youʼre able to comfortably flex across visual design, product thinking, brand, and interaction design.

- Systems thinking: you can design components and patterns while thinking about how they fit into the broader system, but you also know when to push past convention and innovate.

- Courage to challenge ideas, try new things and push a product direction forward.

- Fluency designing in Figma and other prototyping tools. You also experiment regularly with new tooling.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills. We have an async work culture.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment, where the stakes are high and priorities can shift quickly. Bonus points if you have both in-house (especially at a startup) and agency experience.

WHAT WE OFFER:

- Remote-first, Europe-based (but must be within CET +/-3 hours)

- Competitive salary + eVSOPS

- Backed by leading VCs like HV Capital, byFounders, Notion Capital

❤️ In the end, it’s all about the team and our culture. Understand why we love our job and see what it’s like to work at Cello in our People Playbook https://app.notion.com/p/People-Playbook-59cf404a0de5444ab0732ec905925179?pvs=21. We have some compelling perks and benefits.

Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint , and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.
Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform - and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. title: Solution Consultant - R&D
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.
